messages.author: 7942473998baeb45
messages.subject: Error with EBImage
parts:
Hi,
I receive this message when I attempt to plot an Image.
Both ImageMagick and GTK+ are installed and added to my or system-wide
PATH variable.
I am using R version 2.6.1 on windows with EBImage 2.2.0.
Has anyone else seen this error and if so is there a fix?
Thanks in advance for your help,

Jason

> plotImage(cf)
Loading required package: EBImage
Error in dyn.load(file, ...) :
unable to load shared library 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-26~1.1/library/
EBImage/libs/EBImage.dll':
LoadLibrary failure: The specified procedure could not be found.


Error in list("plotImage(cf)" = <environment>,
"plotImage.AffymetrixCelFile(cf)" = <environment>, :

[2007-12-31 11:51:20] Exception: Package not loaded: EBImage.
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Package not loaded: EBImage.")
at throw("Package not loaded: EBImage.")
at getImage.AffymetrixCelFile(this, ...)
at getImage(this, ...)
at plotImage.AffymetrixCelFile(cf)
at plotImage(cf)

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error with EBImage
parts:
Hi Jason,

this seems to be a problem with EBImage. I have Windows and I haven't
seen this. Have you restarted R? Can you confirm that EBImage works
by itself without using aroma.affymetrix? Try the examples of
EBImage. If you have problems with those, please ask for help on the
Bioconductor mailinglist (the mailing list for EBImage).

Cheers

/Henrik

messages.author: 7942473998baeb45
messages.subject: Re: Error with EBImage
parts:
Hi Henrik,

Thanks so much for your reply. I have been able to find a solution to
my problem.
The problem lay in C:\Program Files\Tcl\bin being in the path before
Gtk bin. It seems they have different versions of libxml2.dll.
Thanks again,

Jason Ellul
Junior Bioinformatics Analyst
Bioinformatics Research Department
Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre
